description: This file defines build rules and macros for creating embedded Linux images for the i.MX platform in an OpenWrt build environment. It includes functions for preparing, cleaning, and creating combined images and SD card images, along with steps to incorporate U-Boot, device tree blobs, and kernel images.

methods.name: Build/imx-combined-image-prepare
methods.description: Removes existing boot image file, creates a new directory for boot files.

methods.name: Build/imx-combined-image-clean
methods.description: Removes temporary boot and filesystem images.

methods.name: Build/imx-combined-image
methods.description: Copies kernel image and device tree blobs into a boot directory, creates a boot script image, copies the filesystem image, and generates a generic image using an external script.

methods.name: Build/imx-sdcard
methods.description: Prepares boot images, copies U-Boot images if available, creates combined images, and writes U-Boot SPL to the output device.

methods.name: Build/imx-sdcard-raw-uboot
methods.description: Prepares images for raw U-Boot deployment, similar to `imx-sdcard`, but with different partition scheme and copying U-Boot images into the target device.
